composition_subtypes.role: Suffix array construction by sorting indices with computed keys
LCP array computation using two-pointer technique

payload.core_composition_summary: Uses suffix array sorting and LCP two-pointer to efficiently count distinct substrings starting and ending with given patterns.
payload.rationale: The solution constructs suffix array via custom sorting, then computes LCP with two-pointer, and combines these with pattern matching and binary search to count distinct substrings.
